additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P9 170000893
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
V3noQJ
Problem Description
: Vehicle dropped the sessions with the ERR67
Troubleshooting
:
The ERR67 means that while we were in Charging Phase (PilotState C), the EV suddenly sent a PilotState B (Preparing). I can see that in this date there were 3 different sessions with the (most likely) same EV since they belong to the same manufacturer.
1st session: EVMAC":"00.7d.fa.08.7d.ad"
2nd session: "EVMAC":"00.7d.fa.08.01.a2"
3rd session: "EVMAC":"00.7d.fa.07.b6.82"
You can use this website to check what is the manufacturer: https://www.macvendors.com/
As you can see, they used the same brand everytime. This makes me believe there might be some incompatibility from their side with our charger since this error is very rare. Usually this is error is only seen in heavy duty trucks that have a auxiliary system capable of introducing interference in the PilotState.
If these EVs are not heavy duty trucks, then I can only mention that the EV itself is dropping the session without going through the correct phases.
Please let me know your thought and questions. If I answered to your needs let me know if I can close the ticket.
For future reference, your case number is
0419340
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
